These are AI-tagged observations from public comments and are directional.

results.text: Failed instalments are more common in app reviews than on Reddit. results.q: Do YouTube commenters talk about returns differently from Play Store reviewers?
results.text: YouTube commenters and Play Store reviewers discuss returns differently. Among YouTube commenters, "Returns, profit or loss" is the most frequently tagged check, appearing in 293 of 2,854 comments (10.3%). In contrast, Play Store reviewers focus more on "Portfolio value," which appears in 944 of 5,103 comments (18.5%), while "Returns, profit or loss" is mentioned in 401 of 5,103 comments (7.9%).
